spec.title: Network Observability - Device Investigation
spec.description: Troubleshoot one device anywhere on the global network: identity and state, reachability history, adjacencies and ego network, change and conflict events, and the health of the discovery exporter that polls it.

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.description: Devices in the current poll plus any seen in the last hour, so an unreachable device can still be selected.

panels.description: Identity from network_topology_device_info (last hour, so an unreachable device still shows), state from presence of the device in the current poll and network_topology_device_uptime_seconds (under one hour = recently rebooted), last reboot = sample time minus sysUpTime, adjacencies from network_topology_edge_info, exporter health from network_topology_graph_stale and network_topology_module_last_status.

targets.expr: count(max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", ""))) or vector(0)

count(max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[1h]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[1h]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", "")) unless max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", ""))) or vector(0)

options.defaultContent: The selected device has not been reported by $exporter in the last hour.

panels.title: Reachability - $device
panels.description: Reachable when the device appears in the exporter's current poll (network_topology_device_info); Unreachable when the exporter is reporting but the device is missing. Gaps mean the exporter itself was not reporting. The second row shows whether the exporter's discovery graph was fresh (network_topology_graph_stale = 0) at the same time.

panels.title: Uptime (SNMP sysUpTime)
panels.description: network_topology_device_uptime_seconds for the device. A drop back towards zero is a reboot or an SNMP agent restart; a gap is a period when the device did not answer polls.

panels.title: Ego network - $device and two hops out
panels.description: The selected device at the centre, its direct neighbours on the inner ring and their neighbours on the outer ring, from network_topology_edge_info (links reported in the last hour) and network_topology_device_info. Fill = vendor, shape = tier, red outline = device seen in the last hour but missing from the current poll, red dotted line = link no longer reported. Click any node to re-centre this dashboard on it.

targets.expr: (max by (instance, device_id, vendor, os_version, site) (max_over_time(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter"}[2m])) or (0 * max by (instance, device_id, vendor, os_version, site) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter"}[1h]))))

(max by (src_device, src_port, dst_device, dst_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction) (max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter"}[2m])) or (0 * max by (src_device, src_port, dst_device, dst_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction) (last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Adjacencies
panels.description: Every link in network_topology_edge_info where the device is the source (outbound) or the destination (inbound) during the last hour, seen from the device's side. Lost = reported earlier in the hour but missing from the current poll. Click a neighbour to investigate it.

targets.expr: (max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", "")) or (0 * max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[1h]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[1h]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", ""))))

panels.title: Link presence per adjacency
panels.description: One row per adjacency (local port -> neighbour : remote port, protocol). Up while network_topology_edge_info reports the link, Lost when the exporter is polling but the link is missing (tracked for an hour after it was last seen). Gaps mean the exporter was not reporting.

targets.expr: (max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[2m]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", "")) or (0 * max by (neighbour, local_port, remote_port, discovery_proto, link_kind, direction, side) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",src_device="$device"}[1h]), "neighbour", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "side", "outbound", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",dst_device="$device"}[1h]), "neighbour", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "local_port", "$1", "dst_port", "(.*)"), "remote_port", "$1", "src_port", "(.*)"), "side", "inbound", "", "")))) and on() (count(network_topology_graph_devices_total{instance="$exporter"}) > 0)

panels.title: Events over time
panels.description: Topology change (added / removed / changed) and conflict events from the exporter log stream where the device is src_device or dst_device (structured metadata), counted per interval.

targets.expr: sum by (change_kind, conflict_type) (count_over_time({source="network-topology-exporter", instance="$exporter"} | src_device="$device" or dst_device="$device" [$__auto]))

defaults.noValue: No change or conflict events involve this device in the selected range

panels.title: Change and conflict log - $device
panels.description: Raw topology_change and topology_conflict lines from {source="network-topology-exporter"} for the selected exporter, filtered on the src_device / dst_device structured metadata.

panels.title: Polling context - is it the device or the poller? ($exporter)
Discovery module status
panels.description: network_topology_module_last_status per discovery module of the exporter that polls this device: 0 OK, 1 Degraded, 2 Hard-failed. A failing module explains missing links better than a device fault does.

panels.title: Discovery cycle duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of network_topology_discovery_cycle_duration_seconds (whole cycle) and the slowest module from network_topology_discovery_module_duration_seconds, over 10 minute windows.

panels.title: SNMP walk and credential outcomes
panels.description: Per-minute rate of network_topology_snmp_walks_total by status and network_topology_credential_trials_total by status for the exporter. Rising timeouts or failed credential trials point at the poller or the access path, not the device graph.

panels.title: Federation boundary observations involving $device
panels.description: network_topology_boundary_observation_info rows on the federation hub where the device is the reporting_device or one of the peers: links that cross out of this exporter's discovery scope. Only the hub reports these.

targets.expr: max by (reporting_device, src_port, peer_a, peer_b, proto) (network_topology_boundary_observation_info{instance="$exporter",reporting_device="$device"} or network_topology_boundary_observation_info{instance="$exporter",peer_a="$device"} or network_topology_boundary_observation_info{instance="$exporter",peer_b="$device"})

defaults.noValue: No boundary observations involve this device

panels.title: Exporter at a glance
panels.description: For the exporter polling this device: devices and links in its current graph (network_topology_graph_devices_total, network_topology_graph_edges_total), devices seen in the last hour but missing now, and discovery modules not OK (network_topology_module_last_status > 0).

targets.expr: count(max by (device_id) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter"}[1h])) unless on (device_id) max_over_time(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter"}[2m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Device finder
panels.description: Every device reported by any discovery exporter in the last hour, with its current state (Reachable = in the current poll, Unreachable = seen in the last hour but missing now). Filter a column header to search; click a device to investigate it.

targets.expr: label_replace((max by (instance, device_id, vendor, os_version, site) (max_over_time(network_topology_device_info[2m])) or (0 * max by (instance, device_id, vendor, os_version, site) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h])))), "tier", "$1", "device_id", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*")
